Class Seal

java.lang.Object
game.entities.towers.Tower
game.entities.towers.Seal
public class Seal extends Tower
Manages a melee-based tower that utilizes physical slaps, AOE splashes, and stun effects. Features two upgrade paths: "Wild" for power and area control, and "Raised" for speed and auxiliary helpers.
